title: fix: default harnesses to GPT-6 Sol
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Switch all nine Polli-managed model defaults to `openai/gpt-6-sol`, including OpenClaw. Keep explicit `--model` choices unchanged.
- Update the harness guide and CLI docs; Bloom stays key-only because Polli does not manage its model selection.
- Bump Polli to 0.1.21. Existing local configs are not automatically migrated.
- Verified live catalog/tool support, 265 CLI tests, build and formatting. No credentials changed or paid generation requests made.

gist.headline: Nine terminals, one Sol
gist.blurb: Polli now points nine coding harnesses at GPT-6 Sol by default, OpenClaw included. Your explicit model choices still get the last word.
gist.summary: Polli CLI 0.1.21 sets `openai/gpt-6-sol` as the default for all nine Polli-managed harnesses, including OpenClaw, while preserving explicit `--model` choices and Bloom's key-only setup.
gist.impact: Newly configured harnesses use GPT-6 Sol by default; existing local configs are not automatically migrated, and `--model` overrides still work.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli connecting a cluster of nine small retro coding terminals to a warm, sun-shaped GPT-6 Sol icon, with one terminal labeled OpenClaw. A tiny garden of code-plants ties the harnesses together; her tool belt makes her look like she is setting them up.
